instruction: Fix `truncate` so it only appends '...' when the string is actually longer than n. It currently appends the ellipsis unconditionally.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -22,7 +22,7 @@
 
 def truncate(s, n):
     """Truncate ``s`` to ``n`` characters, appending '...' when truncated."""
-    return s[:n] + "..."
+    return s if len(s) <= n else s[:n] + "..."
